# Feature: Mirror switch — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #30 (Mirror switch) from Switches and Doors before it is used in real levels. Effect: flips every switch in the room. Unique: inverts all switch states at once, globally. Useful: resets or reverses a whole switch puzzle from one point. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** flips every switch in the room.

**So that** resets or reverses a whole switch puzzle from one point.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Mirror switch for the first time in its teaching room (mech-30-mirror-switch-room). Teaching moment: First room: a room of toggles already set mostly right, with the mirror switch by the entrance. A player who presses the mirror switch to see what it does finds every setting inverted and their nearly finished room undone, which teaches that its scope is the whole room and that it is pressed, if at all, before anything else is set. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: One press inverts every switch state in the room at once, toggles and their doors included
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Broken one-time switches are unaffected
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It is a room reset with consequences, not a door opener itself

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Mirror switch's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-30-mirror-switch-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/switches-and-doors.yml mechanic #30.
